long_description.before:
Metriport provides real-time access to comprehensive medical data for 300M+ individuals across the US. Our open-source intelligence platform helps organizations access, analyze, and exchange patient data while integrating with all major healthcare IT systems.

If you’ve been to doctors in the US, you may have encountered the problem: how does a healthcare provider get access to your up-to-date medical history to treat you properly? Reliance on archaic methods is still the norm: typically, you or your provider need to call the facilities where you’ve previously received treatment (assuming you remember them all), just to have them send your records via fax (yep, fax). This can take weeks, only then to have a provider sift through hundreds of pages of unstructured docs, just to figure out basic things like your active medication list, what conditions you may have, latest lab results, etc. This not only delays care—it can cause improper treatment, since the medical history is critical for informing treatment decisions. 

Metriport integrates fragmented medical data from thousands of sources—including both national and state/regional Health Information Exchanges (HIEs), ADTs, EHRs, pharmacies, and labs—through a single API connector. The platform then standardizes, deduplicates, and enriches this data to create a comprehensive longitudinal patient record, with AI-powered clinical summaries. 

Along with a rich understanding of patient health history, healthcare providers also get realtime updates about their patients' health through Metriport. This includes getting notified when a patient is discharged from the hospital, picks up their prescription from the pharmacy, or has a new lab result available. Through this data, care teams get insights across their patient population, helping with 30-day readmissions prediction, care gap closure, risk adjustment, and more.

On top of all of this, Metriport enables healthcare organizations to share net-new clinical information back to all major healthcare IT systems, and to become interoperable with popular EHR systems such as Epic, Cerner, athena, eClinicalWorks, and many more—forming an internet for healthcare data.

Metriport improves both patient and provider lives at the point-of-care, supporting use cases such as medication adherence, transitions of care management, chart prep, and much more. If you want to do work that matters, get in touch with us today.
long_description.after:
Metriport provides real-time access to medical data for 340 million individuals across the US. Its open-source platform turns scattered patient records across all major healthcare IT systems into structured information that gives clinicians what they need, exactly when they need it, to provide the best possible care. 

Metriport manages dozens of connections across all national HIEs and QHINs, state and regional HIEs, ADT networks, pharmacies, labs, and EHRs. It then matches, extracts, standardizes, deduplicates, and enriches records, and converts them into a unified data model, accessible through a single API, data warehouse, or apps directly within an EHR.

In addition to providing longitudinal patient clinical data at the point of care, Metriport offers ambient monitoring, alerting providers in real time as patients are moved through the healthcare system to assist with transitions of care. Metriport also delivers insights on top of the data, like AI medical record summarization, condition suspecting, and surfacing care gaps.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, Metriport processes 4.2 billion network requests a month and returns the first structured record in under 15 seconds. Teams across care delivery, value-based programs, and health tech platforms build on Metriport, including Amazon One Medical, Strive Health, Color, Sollis Health, and Canvas Medical.

one_liner.before: Open-Source Platform for Healthcare Data Intelligence
one_liner.after: Healthcare data infrastructure for next generation care delivery.

Captain delivers the most accurate file search engine built for AI agents. We’ll index data from the sources folks already use like S3, SharePoint, and Google Drive, and easily scale multimodal, petabyte-level content search. We’re the Snowflake for Unstructured Data.

Captain tops the Open-RAG-Benchmark with over 20% higher accuracy than standard RAG pipelines. We achieve this through robust data processing techniques like embedding normalization across modalities, ensuring that representations cluster by semantic content rather than data type.
long_description.after:
Captain syncs complex, multimodal files and cloud storage from sources like S3, SharePoint, and Google Drive, and makes that knowledge searchable for your agents.

Instead of stitching together parsers, embeddings, vector databases, rerankers, and retrieval infrastructure, Captain self-tunes the retrieval pipeline to your data and workloads.

On benchmarks, this improves accuracy from roughly 78% with standard RAG to over 97% by tuning retrieval to the unique structure and content of your data.

Captain is purpose-built for complex, regulated, and high-stakes file search workloads.

Learn more at https://captain.dev

long_description.before:
The bottleneck for consumer AI is shifting from the model to the personal context that model uses. 

Models are already capable of completing most tasks for the average user, but consumer AI products still starts cold and have to rebuild an incomplete picture of the same user before they can personalise well. 

We’re building AI Passport so users can carry the personal context they create through everyday apps into new products, allowing those products to understand them from the first interaction instead of reconstructing the same incomplete picture from scratch. Users decide which parts of their context can move between products, while companies receive better information about their users.

Apps integrate AI Passport through a “Sign in with AI Passport” button, then request specific information for a stated purpose and duration rather than receiving broad, permanent access to everything the Passport holds. The user chooses what to share and can revoke access later, which makes the system particularly useful for sensitive health or financial context that may be valuable for a specific interaction but should not remain available indefinitely.

To support this permission model, AI Passport uses our own vector database as its memory backend, built for fast, compact per-user memory and cryptographically enforced access control. 

We’re building first-party apps that give people reasons to create and use their Passport now, while also integrating it into consumer products with existing audiences across hospitality, travel, finance, and lifestyle.
long_description.after:
Egoist Machines is building the user-owned context layer that will be the unlock for the next generation of consumer AI applications. Our product, AI Passport, lets people carry the personal context they generate in everyday apps into any new product, so it understands them from the first interaction. Tell ChatGPT something and Claude already knows, for example, without any app ever owning your data.

The bottleneck for consumer AI is shifting from the model to context. Models can already handle most everyday tasks for the average user, but every new app starts cold, forcing users to re-explain themselves and forcing businesses to rebuild profiles of data that already exist.

Apps integrate with a "Sign in with AI Passport" button, then request specific information for a stated purpose and duration. Users stay in control of what moves between products and can revoke access later, which matters most for sensitive health and financial context. Under the hood, AI Passport runs on our own vector database built for fast, compact per-user memory with cryptographically enforced access control.

We're building first-party apps that give people a reason to create their Passport today, while integrating it into consumer products with existing audiences of billions.

Our North Star: your context living on your own device, sovereign to you, with every model, app, and agent coming to you.

one_liner.before: Secure, user-owned context for every AI app
one_liner.after: Your personal context, securely portable across every AI app and…
